name: branding-black-band-and-cyan-slash-diamond-logo-letterhead-template
title: Black Band and Cyan Slash Letterhead
whatItIs: A stock-template screenshot of an A4 letterhead with a black top band cut by a cyan diagonal, a centred interlocking-diamond logo, a headline and date row, justified body text, a signature line and a footer with three contact circles above a black band with a cyan wedge.
whatItMeans: Mirrored top and bottom corner shapes frame the page symmetrically, and one cyan accent on black feels crisp and corporate.
techniques: Matching diagonal corner shapes at top and bottom
Centred logo with the tagline beneath
Headline left and date right on one row
Contact details as three icon columns

vocabulary.definition: Matching shapes placed at opposite corners to balance a page.
Address, phone and email arranged in equal columns.
A page layout with placeholder branding and text.
